## Demo 5 (IT infrastructure): VM maintenance plan
The 25 fictional VMs of the IT Infrastructure Space are checked against fixed rules (CPU, memory, disk, backup, security patch, TLS certificate). Every yellow or red reason becomes a **recommended task** (renew certificate, install patch, free up disk space, catch up backup, check an unreachable VM). Tasks that need a restart get a maintenance window, several tasks of one VM are bundled. The result is a **plan proposal**: nothing runs, a person approves.

Start it manually, or POST to `/webhook/vm-maintenance-plan` (optional body `{ "vms": [...] }`). Fictional data, no credentials.
